items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I bet he was brother to Buddy. Buddy Lloyd-Kaner.

ctx.x: The bass. The bass. The bass. He was a terrific trombone player, but I never heard it except on record. He was a better bass player.
He was good on both. That's right. I bet he was brother to Buddy. Buddy Lloyd-Kaner.
And that's Eddie Powers next to De La Roche. Yeah, man.
